content_en.prompt: A map shows 5 towns (black dots) and 4 highways (coloured lines). We want a diagram where towns are circles, connected by a line if they lie on the same highway.
content_en.question: Which diagram represents the map correctly?
content_en.explanation: Studying the map: A-D share a highway; B-C-D share one; C-D-E share one; D connects to all others. Only diagram C matches all these relations exactly (A misses the C-E connection; B also misses C-E; D adds false connections A-B and A-E).
content_en.ct_explanation: Computer programs must represent reality with data; the same reality can often be represented multiple ways, and choosing the right one matters. A graph (vertices + edges) is a commonly used representation, central to the field of Graph Theory. This task shows the same reality can be drawn as different-looking (but functionally different!) graphs — care is needed to represent relationships correctly, not just visually similarly.

content_zh.prompt: 地圖上有5座城鎮（黑點）和4條公路（彩色線段）。我們想用「城鎮是圓圈、同一條公路上的城鎮之間連一條線」的方式畫成示意圖。
content_zh.question: 下面哪張示意圖正確代表了這張地圖？
content_zh.explanation: 仔細研究地圖後可以發現：A和D在同一條公路上；B、C、D在同一條公路上；C、D、E在同一條公路上；D跟其他所有城鎮都在同一條公路上。只有圖C完全符合這些關係（圖A漏了C-E的連線；圖B也漏了C-E；圖D多畫了A-B和A-E這兩條不存在的連線）。
content_zh.ct_explanation: 電腦程式必須用資料來表示現實世界；同一個現實情況常常可以用好幾種方式表示，選對表示方式很重要。「圖」（頂點+邊）是很常用的一種表示法，也是「圖論」這門學科的核心。這一題顯示：同樣的現實情況，可以畫成看起來不同（而且功能上真的不同！）的圖——表示關係時要特別小心，不能只看視覺上像不像。
